people.name: Horse_Gate
people.line: A gate in Jerusalem's wall near the temple

translations.web: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.
translations.bsb: Above the Horse Gate, each of the priests made repairs in front of his own house.
translations.kjv: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.
translations.asv: Above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his own house.
